content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Gas producer and power seller in North Texas; it does not distribute propane or serve homes with appliances and tanks."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Primarily a regulated natural gas and electric utility; its propane arm is a small part of a different core business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Regulated electric, gas and steam utility delivering over its own networks; no propane or appliance distribution."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Industrial MRO distributor and pump repair for plants; different customers and products from residential and farm propane."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Plumbing, HVAC and waterworks distributor selling to contractors; does not sell propane to households."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Supermarket and fuel-center retailer; groceries and motor fuel, with no propane distribution or tank rental."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Midstream gathering and processing of Permian gas for producers and petrochemical buyers; not retail propane distribution."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Rents and fabricates compressor equipment for oil and gas producers; different products and customers from propane delivery."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Oil refiner selling gasoline, jet fuel and asphalt; it upstreams fuel rather than delivering propane to homes."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Propane delivery to homes and businesses, with tank rental, appliance installation and repair, matching the target's model."}]}
